allowFontScaling.description: Allow text to be resized based on user's device display scale

children.description: Text to display. Supports nesting text elements.

maxLines.description:
The maximum amount of lines the text can occupy before being truncated with "...".
Uses predefined string values that correspond to a doubling scale for the amount of lines.

reverseTheme.description: Uses the reverse variant of the text color for the heading

selectable.description:
Lets the user select text, to use the native copy and paste functionality.
WARNING: if true, this prevents ellipsis from being shown on Android.
